title: Democrats' sweep sparks an AI rout: Nasdaq loses 3.4% for the week, and oil sinks 12% on Iran peace hopes
short: AI rout after Democrats' sweep; oil sinks 12% on Iran peace hopes
dek: Wall Street had its worst day since April 2025 on fears that a Democratic Congress will curb AI data centres. Oil fell sharply on hopes of an end to the Iran conflict, and strong jobs data raised the odds of a December Fed hike.
card: Chip stocks fell 12% in a day, the Nasdaq lost 3.4% for the week, and Brent crude dropped about 12%.
